mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course ( city_id, user_id, title, description, theme, start_time, end_time, total_duration_minutes, total_travel_minutes, transport ) VALUES ( #{cityId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{theme}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{totalDurationMinutes}, #{totalTravelMinutes}, #{transport} )
INSERT INTO course_place( course_id, place_id, sequence, travel_minutes_from_previous )VALUES ( #{courseId}, #{placeId}, #{sequence}, #{travelMinutesFromPrevious} )
mapper.select: SELECT c.course_id AS courseId, c.city_id AS cityId, city.name AS cityName, c.title, c.description, c.theme, c.total_duration_minutes AS totalDurationMinutes, c.total_travel_minutes AS totalTravelMinutes, c.transport, COALESCE(place_agg.place_count, 0) AS placeCount, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM course c JOIN city city ON c.city_id = city.city_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS place_count FROM course_place GROUP BY course_id ) place_agg ON c.course_id = place_agg.course_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.course_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT c.course_id AS courseId, c.city_id AS cityId, city.name AS cityName, c.user_id AS userId, c.title, c.description, c.theme, c.start_time AS startTime, c.end_time AS endTime, c.total_duration_minutes AS totalDurationMinutes, c.total_travel_minutes AS totalTravelMinutes, c.transport, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt, c.deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM course c JOIN city city ON c.city_id = city.city_id WHERE c.course_id = #{courseId} AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT cp.course_place_id AS coursePlaceId, cp.course_id AS courseId, cp.place_id AS placeId, cp.sequence, cp.travel_minutes_from_previous AS travelMinutesFromPrevious, cp.created_at AS createdAt, cp.updated_at AS updatedAt, p.name AS placeName, p.latitude, p.longitude FROM course_place cp JOIN place p ON cp.place_id = p.place_id WHERE cp.course_id = #{courseId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY cp.sequence ASC, cp.course_place_id ASC

SELECT course_id AS courseId, city_id AS cityId, user_id AS userId, title, description, theme, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, total_duration_minutes AS totalDurationMinutes, total_travel_minutes AS totalTravelMinutes, transport, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM course WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET city_id = #{cityId}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, theme = #{theme}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, total_duration_minutes = #{totalDurationMinutes}, total_travel_minutes = #{totalTravelMinutes}, transport = #{transport} WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
